title: Partial Petrial Polynomials of Ribbon Graphs
summary: Gross, Mansour, and Tucker [European J. Combin., 95 (2021): 103329] introduced the \emph{partial Petrial polynomial} of a ribbon graph $G$, denoted by $^{\partial}{\varepsilon^{\times}_{G}}(z)$. Beck and Mellor proved, in both orientable and non-orientable cases respectively, that the Euler genus of a bouquet equals the rank of a certain matrix over $\mathbb{GF}(2)$. In this paper, we first generalize Beck and Mellor's results from bouquets to all ribbon graphs.
